prompt: In which year did a team achieve the highest score in a World Baseball Classic (WBC) championship game, leading them to victory in their first-ever WBC final?
answer: **2006.** Japan scored the highest winning total in a WBC championship game, defeating Cuba **10–6** in the inaugural WBC final—Japan’s first-ever final appearance and title.
